guidance: Use a centralized IdP (AWS IAM Identity Center, Okta, Azure AD) instead of IAM users and Access Keys to provide temporary credentials and reduce long-term credential risk. IAM Identity Center's built-in directory is sufficient if no external IdP exists. Integrate the identity repository with your HR system to automatically revoke access when employees leave.
how_to_check: Are employees authenticating via a centralized IdP rather than IAM users and Access Keys? Is the identity repository integrated with HR for automatic access revocation when employees leave? For more information, please refer to the documentation.
